name: get_paideia_folder_contents
description: Queue a live, read-only inspection of one Moodle folder and return its visible nested files through get_paideia_job_status. Does not download files. Includes live-clock academicContext. Use referenceWeek and explicit section labels before choosing current materials; use referenceDate for a future class. calendar_unavailable requires verifying and recording a program calendar, not assuming week 1.

referenceDate.description: Optional target class date for material matching; does not replace the current server date.
